item.title: 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
# Cursor Switch 1.0 beta 1
The first shareable beta of Cursor Switch for macOS 15 and newer.
- Switch between your normal macOS cursor and a custom cursor from the menu bar. - Choose a shape, SF Symbol, emoji, or your own transparent image. - Adjust size and supported colors. - Align clicks to the topmost visible pixel, with manual positions available. - Get later beta builds through Check for Updates… in the menu bar. - The app stays out of the Dock and restores the native cursor when it quits.
Custom cursors keep the same artwork over text and links. Cursor replacement uses a macOS compatibility layer; please report flicker, positioning issues, or trouble with fullscreen apps or multiple displays.
